question: The famous novel ‘The God Of Small Things’ is written by ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arundhati Roy**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arundhati Roy** is the author of the famous novel 'The God Of Small Things'.
 
• The novel was published in 1997 and won the Booker Prize in the same year.
 
• It is a semi-autobiographical work and deals with themes of forbidden love and social discrimination in Kerala, India.
 
• Arundhati Roy is also known for her work as an activist focusing on issues of social justice and economic inequality.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'The God Of Small Things'** is set in the village of Ayemenem in Kerala.
 
• The book explores the lives of fraternal twins Rahel and Estha and their dysfunctional family.
 
• It delves into how small things affect people's behavior and their lives.
 
• Arundhati Roy's writing style in this novel is noted for its vivid imagery and complex narrative structure.
 
• The novel has been translated into several languages and has garnered international acclaim.
